name: Wayward Haint

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours.

traits.name: Bottle Trap
traits.summary: Entering the space of an upright empty bottle: DC 16 Cha save or it is sucked in and corked.
traits.text: If the haint moves into a space holding an empty bottle standing upright, it makes a DC 16 Charisma saving throw. On a failure it is pulled inside and a stopper seals the bottle. Bottled, it can see and hear 10 feet out and be heard that far. Breaking or opening the bottle lets it out.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.summary: Moves through creatures and objects as Difficult Terrain; 5 (1d10) Force if it ends a turn inside one.
traits.text: The haint passes through creatures and objects as though they were Difficult Terrain, and takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

opening_wail.name: Opening Wail
opening_wail.summary: Its first turn in the fight is a wail: it does nothing else.
opening_wail.text: A haint turned hostile spends its first turn wailing its grief, which warns the party what it has become (ours, R10 decision 28).

lovelorn.name: Lovelorn
lovelorn.summary: Strikes, then drifts back through the cabin walls; her weeping can frighten a hero.
lovelorn.text: The Sweetheart never stays to be struck back: she touches, then slips away through the nearest wall. While she weeps, one hero at a time must make a DC 12 Wisdom save or be Frightened until the end of their next turn (ours, fun pass).

last_song.name: Last Song
last_song.summary: Every other round her song holds the heroes in the lounge still unless they shake it off.
last_song.text: The Songstress sings the last bars she never finished. From the second round, every other round, each hero in the car makes a DC 12 Wisdom save or stands Incapacitated, listening, until the end of their next turn (ours, fun pass).

food_fight.name: Food Fight
food_fight.summary: Throws phantom suppers from across the car, then ducks behind the booths.
food_fight.text: The Daydreamer hurls plates and pies conjured from the dining car's kitchen: each round one hero makes a DC 12 Dexterity save or takes 1d6 Bludgeoning damage. He strikes and pulls back between the booths (ours, fun pass).

heaving_deck.name: Heaving Deck
heaving_deck.summary: The mail car's floor rolls like a ship's deck in a gale.
heaving_deck.text: The Mariner brings the sea with him: each round the floor heaves, and every hero makes a DC 12 Strength save or falls Prone (ours, fun pass).

flung_baggage.name: Flung Baggage
flung_baggage.summary: Hurls cases and trunks across the baggage car.
flung_baggage.text: The Jailbird swings his chain through the stacked luggage: each round a case flies at one hero, who makes a DC 12 Dexterity save or takes 1d6 Bludgeoning damage (ours, fun pass).

pratfall_panic.name: Pratfall Panic
pratfall_panic.summary: Tumbles and cartwheels round the stage, and her grin can frighten a hero.
pratfall_panic.text: The Harlequin strikes and springs away across the stage. Each round one hero makes a DC 12 Wisdom save or is Frightened of her painted grin until the end of their next turn (ours, fun pass).

actions.name: Draining Regret
actions.summary: +4, 3d6 Psychic and 1 Exhaustion (not past 5; this Exhaustion ends on a rest or Lesser Restoration).
actions.text: Its grief washes over the target: 10 (3d6) Psychic damage and one level of Exhaustion. This can't take the target past 5 levels, and every level it gave goes away when the target finishes a Short or Long Rest or receives Lesser Restoration or similar magic.

summary: A lost soul tied to the regret it can't let go of: it drifts through walls, and its touch leaves the living worn out with sorrow.
